en.headline: sogeisetsu: 10 own commits across 3 repos, plus 22 automated commits
en.summary: Across three repositories, `sogeisetsu` made **10 own commits** on 2026-10-18. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 5 commits made the `skill_management` spec self-contained, added a Steps checklist, moved plans to `.openchamber/plans`, and unified line endings to LF. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 4 commits fixed duplicate resident-issue creation, narrowed the `verify` invariant scan, made notifier failures degrade gracefully, and shipped AI failure visibility, model labeling, and a 30-day summary revision; `github-actions[bot]` added 22 automated commits on top. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 1 commit documented a new `opencode-provider` category covering catalog sources, credentials, endpoints, and OpenChamber jurisdiction. The user commented on `openchamber/openchamber#4939` about the selection-menu bug, and started discussion #5114 "[Idea] Split the rendered-page selection-menu fix: frame→host selection bridge first (#4939)". Two replies were received in upstream issues #4601 and #4899 from `btriapitsyn` and `yulia-ivashko`. Upstream maintainer `btriapitsyn` also closed issues #4896, #4920, and #4601. No PRs, reviews, releases, or star events occurred.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 当日 10 次本人提交，另有 22 次 github-actions 自动提交
zh.summary: 当天 `sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库共有 **10 次本人提交**。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 中，5 次提交把 `skill_management` 规范改为自含文档、补充 Steps 清单、将计划移入 `.openchamber/plans` 并统一换行符为 LF。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，4 次提交修复了常住 issue 重复创建问题、收窄 `verify` 不变式的扫描范围、让 notifier 失败时优雅降级，并带来 AI 失败可见性、模型标注与 30 天总结改版；`github-actions[bot]` 另有 22 次自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，1 次提交新增了 `opencode-provider` 类别文档，涵盖 catalog 三层来源、凭据归属、端点与 OpenChamber 管辖。该用户评论了 `openchamber/openchamber#4939`（选中文本无法打开评论菜单的问题），并发起讨论 #5114「[Idea] Split the rendered-page selection-menu fix: frame→host selection bridge first (#4939)」。收到 2 条上游 issue 回复，分别来自 `btriapitsyn`（#4601）与 `yulia-ivashko`（#4899）；维护者 `btriapitsyn` 还关闭了 #4896、#4920 与 #4601。当天无 PR、无 review、无 release、无 star 事件。
